notes.title: Simplified Chinese has been added to The Married Manager's Scandalous Services!
notes.content:
[h1]Simplified Chinese has been added to The Married Manager's Scandalous Services - The Pleasures of the Night Shift.[/h1]

[b][How to play the Simplified Chinese version][/b]
1. Open your Steam Library.
2. Right click the game's title and select Properties.
3. Select "Simplified Chinese" from the language list and launch the game.
(*Update required.)
